message.content: Java is a high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language designed to have as few implementation dependencies as possible. It was originally developed by James Gosling at Sun Microsystems (which was later acquired by Oracle Corporation) and released in 1995. Java is known for its portability across platforms, thanks to the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), which allows Java programs to run on any device that has a JVM implementation. The language is widely used for building enterprise-scale applications, Android mobile apps, web services, and many other types of software.
